external_integration.purpose: Asserts compatibility with the real external provider constellation or sibling workspaces (KOL_Master corpus/artifacts, committed provider manifests and their generated registry). Deselected from the portable CI gate by marker.

tests.rationale: Asserts importer behavior against the real external KOL_Master capability corpus (sibling workspace): corpus-specific row counts (997 capabilities, 386 priority annotations), frozen hashtable sizes, and provenance checksums. These facts are properties of the external corpus, not of the importer contract, so they are not reproduced by portable fixtures.

local_runtime.purpose: Requires machine-local installed runtime state (installed ~/.kolmafia targets, generated data/runtime registry, installed agent bundle). Deselected from the portable CI gate by marker; runs only on operator hosts.

tests.rationale: Validates actual operator installation state: the portable agent-bundle capability registry and the installed KoLmafia relay helper health. Runs only on operator hosts with the real installation present; missing installations skip precisely.
